description: Boom candidates, v5 = combined ranking with small caps first (size weight, $2M/day liquidity floor, mega caps in a separate strip). v4 combined: status confirmed (ranked by upside/risk) -> waiting (by combined score) -> filtered (watchlist). Earlier ranks kept: rank_upside (v3), rank_echo (v2), rank_old (v1)
ranking: filters: late call (20%+ prior-month run) or price broken -> filtered; confirmation: day up 5%+ on 1.5x volume or close above 20-day high after the call; v5 small caps first: under $2M/day traded -> filtered; confirmed ranked by up_risk_ratio (upside estimate / risk to story-wrong stop) x size_w, waiting by combined score x size_w (size_w < $2B 2.0, $2-10B 1.4, $10-200B 0.85, > $200B 0.6 and moved to the large caps strip); boom_score = sort_score; low_float flagged. Backtest: maps/ranking_backtest.md
